preconditions.description: The input is a non-empty string with length at most 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c.isdigit() or c == '.' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of lowercase English letters, digits, and dots.
The input is guaranteed to follow the bill format: alternating non-empty names (lowercase letters) and valid prices, starting with a name and ending with a price.

postconditions.description: The output is a string without leading or trailing whitespace.

postconditions.expression: total_cents == sum(int(p.split('.')[0].replace('.', '')) * 100 + int(p.split('.')[1]) if '.' in p else int(p.replace('.', '')) * 100 for p in [part for part in re.split(r'([a-z]+)', stdin) if part and part[0].isdigit()])
postconditions.description: The output represents the sum of all prices in the bill, where each price is parsed by removing thousands separators (dots in the dollar part) and converting to cents, then summed.
The output string is the formatted representation of the total sum in cents, using dots as thousands separators in the dollar part and a dot followed by two digits for the cents part.
